items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Shadow was there, Rodney Richardson was on bass

ctx.x: Shadow Wilson. I had him to play in my place for one week because I went down to Washington. They wanted me to go into the Navy Band but Mr. Glenn Miller had sent a brown envelope- you know, Glenn had the overlay for the musicians going into the Army and he was placing various peoples. Shadow was there, Rodney Richardson was on bass,
